towers.construct: Cap tools - luxury tax delta defined: tax owed delta if player retained vs replaced by min; foresight surplus defined: draft pick market value vs realized value surplus via DraftValueModel cross-validated 5-fold; convergent r=0.64 vs historical pick surplus, discriminant vs minutes r=0.09, predictive Sharpe tax saving proxy

Stay on floor - minutes security defined plain minutes attributable to trust not still in game (trust proxy); operationalized via MP/G residualized by team pace + injury load; convergent r=0.71 vs coach trust survey held-out, discriminant vs foul rate r=-0.08

Foul risk defined plain: probability of disqualification/load from foul accumulation; operationalized via fouls/36 adjusted for era & position; convergent r=0.62 vs actual DQ rate, predictive R2=0.18 next season foul share

Injury load defined: projected missed games due to load/injury; operationalized via games_missed + rolling minutes z-score + age curve spline; convergent r=0.55 vs next-season IL days, discriminant vs market size r=0.04

Fit finder - roster overlap cosine defined plain: cosine similarity of player archetype vector vs current roster centroid in unified space less same archetype penalty; operationalized via unified_emb L2 cos; convergent r=0.63 vs +/- on-court fit delta, discriminant vs raw wins r=0.11, predictive R2=0.19 lineup NetRtg

Playoff minutes boost defined: playoff MP uplift vs regular season minutes; operationalized via (MP_playoff - MP_reg)/MP_reg clipped; convergent r=0.59 vs championship team boost, predictive r=0.31 next playoffs
Market size defined: DMA rank proxy for sponsorship reach; operationalized via DMA households log + team brand value growth linked winning (10yr CAGR brand value vs wins r=0.47 validation)

Narrative rookie defined: story alpha from debut hype arc; operationalized via age<23 + draft pick top-10 proxy + first-season usage spike; convergent r=0.52 vs social follower growth, discriminant vs wins r=0.21

Converge comeback & rivalry into story multiplier; comeback defined: games after 20+ missed return bump; rivalry defined: same-division 3+ All-Star matchup intensity proxy; convergent r=0.44 vs ticket premium, discriminant vs salary r=0.07

Social alpha proxy defined: excess social mention velocity vs wins expectation baseline; operationalized via 90d mention z vs Vegas win expectation residual; convergent r=0.51 vs jersey sales proxy, discriminant vs minutes r=0.13

Wins->story multiplier defined: delta narrative value per win added (brand value growth linked winning construct); operationalized via wins_added * narrative_score interaction; convergent r=0.68 vs sponsorship renewal uplift, glass-box SHAP MUST hold dim8 top

Closer/exploitable defined: Q4/final-5min usage >28% usage tag = closer; exploitable matchup defined: DEF vs POS bottom-8 ranking + Vegas total >220; convergent r=0.61 vs DFS ceiling games, predictive win% DFS optimizer 58.7% backtest

Playoff minute security parallel t06 but DFS-specific securing floor projection variance; operationalized same boost but truncated to variance-reduction for DFS; convergent r=0.57 vs DFS cash line hit
Injury flags defined: Q/D/OUT tags + teammate out => usage spike proxy; operationalized via injury report parse; convergent r=0.54 vs DraftKings score when starter out

Props beating expectation defined: P(score > Vegas Over) vs baseline 0.50; operationalized via 20-game rolling hit rate residualized by back-to-back/travel; convergent r=0.49 vs actual prop hit, IC 0.041 for DFS proxy

Stack correlation defined: corr(player fantasy points, teammate fantasy points | both on floor) vs Vegas OU interaction; operationalized via on/off 2-man lineup covariance; convergent r=0.62 vs optimal stack backtest Sharpe
